The endpoint allows you to view the list of all users and devices for a given software name and v...
GET
https://api.zsapi.net/zdx/v1/inventory/softwares/:software_key

The endpoint allows you to view the list of all users and devices for a given software name and version.

Request
​
PATH PARAMETERS
software_key
string
REQUIRED
QUERY PARAMETERS
loc
integer[]

The Zscaler location (ID). You can add multiple location IDs.

dept
integer[]

The department (ID). You can add multiple department IDs.

geo
string[]

The active geolocation (ID). You can add multiple active geolocation IDs.

userids
integer[]

The user IDs.

deviceids
integer[]

The device IDs.

Responses
​
200
401
403

Software Group Overview

APPLICATION/JSON
Schema
Example (auto)
SCHEMA
software
object[]
next_offset
string
